title: Foliated Minimal Models and Flops
summary: We study minimal models and flops for foliations. We show that if $\mathcal F$ is a rank one foliation with canonical singularities on a normal projective $\mathbb Q$-factorial variety and $K_{\mathcal F}$ is pseudo-effective, then any two outputs of the $K_{\mathcal F}$-MMP are isomorphic. For co-rank one foliations on threefolds, we prove existence results for $D$-flops in the klt setting and, under additional hypotheses, in the F-dlt setting.
